title: Complete project sharing and compact message previews with bounded display authorization
summary: Implement the approved permission-aware project preview across in-app cards, external metadata and real PNGs, with eligible team stacks, canonical skills, active vacancies, read-only metrics and no missing-image box. Preserve validated explicit content destinations, canonical general links, original-intent receipt recovery and existing Messages design. Constrain first-party message cards to half the lane and keep unchanged content stable through bounded authorization renewal. Follow-up aligns project avatars/chips to box geometry and reuses the detail-page role formatter with consent-aware active guidance labels.
dataSourcesChanged: Existing verified viewer context projected to actor ID and a SHA-256 session binding
Existing first-party sharing reader and private no-store preview response
Existing in-memory TanStack Query cache, author preview-hidden mutation and private user broadcast topics
Existing project access resolver, visible skill edges, active role seats and read-only view/follower aggregates
Existing profile privacy and current project owner/member roster filtered before limit and overflow
Existing verified owner/project-matched storage assets, local bounded image reads and post-render permission rechecks
Existing idempotent message receipts with an explicit receipt-only no-write lookup
Existing accepted role applications, lead focus and active guidance attribution with the same visibility policy as the project detail page
concurrencyRisk: A server-issued display lease lasts at most 60 seconds and never exceeds verified token expiry. The client validates actor/session/resource binding, charges request time and uses both monotonic and wall deadlines. Failed, expired, offline, suspended or known-revoked authorization masks protected content. AbortSignal prevents canceled/previous-account reads from restoring it. Shared query keys are versioned for the new cache shape and inactive cache retention never grants display access. Existing author/live-channel server authorization remains unchanged. Resource notifications are best effort; visible 30-second reads and expiry bound missed remote events. This is a UI freshness lease, never server authorization. Project/team eligibility is checked before bounded aggregation and after asynchronous reads; image assets and final security-sensitive projections are rechecked after rendering. Counter changes do not invalidate the security signature. Unknown sends retain original idempotency identity across draft changes and use receipt-only reconciliation before deliberate original-intent retry. The final access recheck also discards results if membership changed while reading private guidance attribution.

logs: Browser test attachments record requests, stable DOM identity and React Profiler commits

rollback.strategy: Revert only the project sharing projection/rendering, receipt recovery and scoped message preview display integration. Preserve unrelated workspace changes and existing Messages design. No migration, dependency or data rollback.
validation: Fresh server authorization still gates every preview read
No private snapshot survives account cleanup
Unrelated message navigation, composer and attachments retain their design
